he: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שָׂ֭מַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֑י בֵּ֖ית יְהֹוָ֣ה נֵלֵֽךְ׃
en: A song of the ascents, to Dovid: I rejoiced when they said to me: To the House of Havayah we shall go.
Our feet were standing in your gates, Yerushalayim.
Yerushalayim the built, as a city that was joined to it together.

he: שֶׁשָּׁ֨ם עָל֪וּ שְׁבָטִ֡ים שִׁבְטֵי־יָ֭הּ עֵד֣וּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ֝הֹד֗וֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
en: For there went up tribes, the tribes of Yah, a testimony to Yisrael, to thank the name of Havayah.

he: כִּ֤י שָׁ֨מָּה ׀ יָשְׁב֣וּ כִסְא֣וֹת לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֝סְא֗וֹת לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִֽד׃
en: For there sat thrones for judgment, thrones for the house of Dovid.
Ask the peace of Yerushalayim; those who love you shall be at ease.
Let there be peace in your wall, ease in your palaces.

he: לְ֭מַעַן אַחַ֣י וְרֵעָ֑י אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּ֖א שָׁל֣וֹם בָּֽךְ׃
en: For the sake of my brothers and my fellows, I shall speak now peace in you.

he: לְ֭מַעַן בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁ֖ה ט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃ {פ}
en: For the sake of the House of Havayah our Elokim, I shall seek good for you.
